answer: Admission auction: 40 identities enter per epoch. Applicants bid POA; the top 40 pay the clearing price, 2,000 POA, burned. A quartz-clear ledger lists every bid, so one wallet's thread is visible. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must win 25 auctions, burning 1,000 x 2,000 = 2,000,000 POA. Each identity earns 150 POA per epoch, so payback takes over 13 epochs. An honest agent pays once, keeps rewards whole; a violet flag marks clustered bids.
